name: Imose Mami
source:
Characteristics: daydreaming masochist. Her weak point is her back.
Special skills: general housekeeping, aikido.

She may appear calm and relaxed, but she is surprisingly firm.
She is a bit preachy with her noisy younger sisters and is particular about etiquette.
On the other hand, when she is alone with her brother, she can be a spoiled brat.
She has an inferiority complex about her smaller breasts compared to her sisters (although they're sill big enough).
"I'm not as cute as the other sisters..." she thinks.
She loves to read, mostly fairy tales. She also likes erotic novels.

[Translated from [url=http://lovebitch.jp/imoto-tokku/index.html]Official Website[/url]]
